details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:258-287 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: dispatch_watch_alt_model_runner_wait returns `ALT_MODEL_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=timeout reason=held` as soon as any run of the alt-model issue is `pending`/`waiting` (the `for alt_rw_held_status in pending waiting` loop), or any job of a queued candidate is held (the queued-candidate jq `held` verdict). The gate's own 600s `/approved` re-post creates exactly that state: an implement peer queued behind the `ai-implement-<repo>-<issue>` concurrency group.
  WHY: In the run 45296809251 scenario the check ends `held` and never reaches `runner_wait`. The step exits 1, the gate fails, an attempt is spent and a heal issue is filed, so G3 cannot fire in the case it targets. All reviewers rate this MAJOR.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:247-305 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Queued and in-progress candidates now share the `ALT_RUNNER_WAIT_MAX_RUNS` (default 5) cap through `alt_rw_read_count`. Comment-triggered wrapper runs that reuse the issue title as `display_title` push the count past 5, and the check returns `timeout reason=too_many_runs`.
  WHY: In a long runner wait with `/approved` re-posts, the cap fires before job states are classified, so the gate burns an attempt where G3 wanted none. All reviewers rate this MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2072, 2193-2200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "only failed step" jq (line 2072) and the `HEAL_RUNNER_WAIT_FAILED_IDS` filter (2193-2195) accept only `conclusion in ("failure", "timed_out")` and exclude `cancelled`. As a result, the G4 skip at line 2186 never fires when `dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate` cancels the gate.
  WHY: Both reporters rate this BLOCKER: every runner-wait cancel would still file a heal issue and count as a failed attempt. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this and dismissed it. Their reason is that workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:102-103 admits only `failure`/`timed_out` runs, so a cancelled gate run is never processed, and on the `stop_failed` path the watch step concludes `failure`.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:273-297 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In the queued-candidate loop, the `too_many_runs`, `jobs_unreadable` and `held` verdicts each `return 0` immediately (lines 278, 294). One transient jobs-read failure on a queued candidate therefore aborts the whole alt-model check before any in-progress candidate is examined.
  WHY: A momentary API blip flips the decision from `runner_wait` to `timeout`, costs a release attempt and files a heal issue; the previous implementation did not have this failure mode.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2207 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The G4 skip is gated by `HEAL_RUNNER_WAIT_COUNT -le "${MAX_FAILED_JOBS}"` (default 3), so a gate with more than 3 failed jobs, all carrying the `RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT` marker, still files a heal issue.
  WHY: The cap exists for log collection, but the G4 skip uses a different signal. A wider gate can fail six watch steps on a runner wait.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:287-291 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The queued-candidate `held` verdict matches `status IN ("waiting", "pending") AND runner_name == ""` but never checks that `conclusion` is null.
  WHY: A job that has already started, under a parent run still reported as `queued` and briefly showing `waiting`/`pending`, could trip `held` and abort the alt-model check. Rated NIT.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:339-348 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate` waits up to `DISPATCH_WATCH_STOP_WAIT_SECS` (default 240) without logging on each loop iteration.
  WHY: Debug-only. An operator who sees only `stop_failed detail=still_running` cannot tell whether the cancel was applied. Rated NIT. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G3 — "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'." (workflow-log-analysis child)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, the `workflow-log-analysis-test` job / `Dispatch & snapshot — workflow-log-analysis` step
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The "Cancel dispatched child runs when the gate is cancelled" step exists only at lines 4082 (orphan-workflows-test) and 4647 (validate-standalone-test). `test_gate_workflow_wires_the_alt_model_check_and_child_cancels` asserts a count of exactly 2. The workflow-log-analysis child stays alive after the gate stops itself. The previous editor deferred this, but the issue does not.
- requirement: G3: "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started." (e2e-smoke fixture children)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, the e2e-smoke-test job (and, residually, the e2e-alt-model-test job), which needs an `if: cancelled()` "Cancel dispatched child runs" step
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The cancel steps cover only orphan-workflows-test (lines 4082-4096) and validate-standalone-test (lines 4647-4661), and the test asserts `== 2`. The existing "Cleanup test artifacts" step cancels Implement runs only in the no-PR branch, plus review runs by branch. It does not cancel active Clarify/Plan runs, so the smoke issue's fixture children keep holding or queueing runner slots after the gate ends.
- requirement: G4 — "The workflow-failure-heal intake does not file an issue for a gate run whose only failed steps ended as runner_wait. It logs the skip with the run id."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 2070-2072 and 2193-2195 (the "only failed step" jq and the `HEAL_RUNNER_WAIT_FAILED_IDS` filter)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both filters check `conclusion in ("failure", "timed_out")` only and do not include `cancelled`. The new tests `test_intake_files_a_runner_wait_job_with_a_second_failed_step` and `test_intake_skips_a_release_gate_run_whose_only_failures_are_runner_waits` use `_runner_wait_job(...)`, which hardcodes `conclusion="failure"`.
- requirement: Tests — "Heal intake: a gate run with only runner_wait steps files nothing; one with a real failed step files as today." (cancelled-conclusion coverage)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Every runner-wait skip test uses conclusion="failure" and none uses conclusion="cancelled". `_runner_wait_job` (line 2977) hardcodes `conclusion="failure"`, so the production `cancelled` path is uncovered.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:dispatch_watch_alt_model_runner_wait, the new `for alt_rw_held_status in pending waiting; do ... alt_rw_result timeout held ...` loop, and the new queued-candidate jq verdict `elif any(.jobs[] | select(type == "object"); ((.status // "") | tostring | IN("waiting", "pending")) and (((.runner_name // "") | tostring) == "")) then "held"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check returns `timeout reason=held` whenever any run of the issue, or any job of one of its queued runs, is `pending`/`waiting`. The gate's own `/approved` re-post every 600s (.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 5089-5124) creates such a pending implement peer in the `ai-implement-<repo>-<issue>` concurrency group (.github/workflows/implement.yml lines 165-167).
  WHY: In run 45296809251 the check prints `ALT_MODEL_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=timeout reason=held` with no `runner_wait=true` and no `RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT`. The step exits 1, the gate fails, an attempt is spent and a heal issue is filed.
- Verified and dismissed: the minimax claim that the jq at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2072 and the `HEAL_RUNNER_WAIT_FAILED_IDS` filter skip `cancelled` steps. A cancelled gate run is never admitted by .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:103 (`failure`/`timed_out` only). Not a defect.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: G3 — "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'." | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, the `workflow-log-analysis-test` job (its `Dispatch & snapshot — workflow-log-analysis` step dispatches with `--snapshot-only` and does not watch the child)
  Evidence of absence: The cancel step exists only at lines 4082 and 4647. `test_gate_workflow_wires_the_alt_model_check_and_child_cancels` asserts exactly 2. e2e-smoke and the alt-model fixture are partly covered by the cleanup steps at line 3017 and line 5270.
- HARDENING: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh dispatch_watch_alt_model_runner_wait. Before returning `held`, check for a queued candidate whose jobs are all `status=queued`, have no runner, and were created at or before `ALT_RW_TWO_THIRDS`. If one exists, log `held_behind_runner_wait=1` and keep classifying. Estimated 6-8 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2193-2200 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The HEAL_RUNNER_WAIT_FAILED_IDS filter only includes conclusion="failure" or conclusion="timed_out", excluding conclusion="cancelled".
  WHY: dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate cancels the gate run, which then concludes cancelled, so these runs are filed as heal issues instead of being skipped as G4 requires.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:273-287 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Any pending or waiting run/job of the alt-model issue is classified as held and results in timeout.
  WHY: The implement peer is often held by a concurrency group, which produces outcome=timeout and a heal issue instead of a runner-wait classification as G3 requires.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:247-251 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Queued and in-progress runs share the 5-run cap.
  WHY: Comment-triggered wrapper runs (/approved posts) quickly exceed 5 queued candidates, and the check exits with timeout reason=too_many_runs.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Cancel the gate's child runs when it stops. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, the workflow-log-analysis-test job and its Dispatch & snapshot — workflow-log-analysis step.
  Evidence of absence: The cancellation logic added to other jobs is absent here, so the child run stays alive after the gate stops itself.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Tests coverage for the runner-wait-cancel production path. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py.
  Evidence of absence: All runner-wait skip tests use conclusion="failure"; none uses conclusion="cancelled".
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
